nodes.label: 2026-08-11-tag-vocabulary-inventory.md — the first inventory of the herb-eval tag layer computed from the tag strings themselves. Every prior measurement of this layer (the 08-02 corpus-facts doc, the retag discussions) was computed one level above the strings — set intersections against source fields, digit regexes, embedding clusters — without anyone reading them. Everything is measured fact or a verbatim string, with the interpretive lines fenced in a single [READING] section; no recommendation is made anywhere, and what to do about the vocabulary is not this doc's question.

Sources. S1 (primary, on-disk): v3/output/derived_facet_cache/herb-eval__pilot_full_herb__nn25__cls20__par0__prior0.5/facets.npz — arrays tag and chunk_id, 67,913 rows, one per HAS_TAG edge, written by build_facet_layer.py from herb-eval; all statistics are computed from these two arrays unless stated. S2 (live cross-check, read-only Cypher on herb-eval 2026-08-11): count(t)=19,716, count(HAS_TAG)=67,913, max(size(t.name))=94, the two names ≥90 chars returned verbatim — all four agree exactly with S1, so the snapshot is a faithful copy of the live DB including the longest strings unclipped; herb was never touched. S3 (corroborating manifest): the tag_distance_cache manifest's n_tags 19716. Methodology: numpy default_rng(20260811), samples without replacement from alphabetically sorted pools; normalization for duplicate checks = casefold with every non-alphanumeric run → one space; plural folding = crude suffix strip; substring and token-set containment computed over the FULL vocabulary, not sampled.

Size and shape [MEASURED]: 19,716 unique tag strings, 67,913 chunk→tag edges, 4,869 chunks. Zero duplicate (tag, chunk) pairs, so a tag's edge count equals its distinct-chunk count. Degree max 534, mean 3.44, median 1. Distribution: 1 chunk — 12,924 tags (65.55%) carrying 12,924 edges (19.03%); 2 chunks — 2,887 (14.64%) / 5,774 (8.50%); 3–20 chunks — 3,429 (17.39%) / 20,874 (30.74%); 21+ chunks — 476 (2.41%) / 28,341 (41.73%). Head of the exact distribution: deg 1: 12,924 · 2: 2,887 · 3: 1,065 · 4: 644 · 5: 377 · 6: 311 · 7: 176 · 8: 160 · 9: 132 · 10: 109. The circulating '65.6% of tags reach 1 chunk, 2.4% reach 21+ carrying 41.7% of edges' is confirmed as 65.55% / 2.41% / 41.73%, and the 08-02 doc's '2,881 tags (14.6%) contain a digit' is confirmed exactly at 2,881 (14.61%).

The mega-tags — top 50 by chunk degree [MEASURED]. They carry 9,157 edges = 13.48% of all edges; salesforce alone touches 534 of 4,869 chunks (11.0% of the chunk population). The leaders: salesforce 534 · tensorflow 428 · apache_kafka 340 · gdpr 287 · machine_learning 255 · kubernetes 244 · natural_language_processing 242 · sprint_review 239 · unit_tests 235 · data_privacy 227 · slack 205 · predictive_analytics 195 · code_review 193 · ccpa 184 · bug_resolution 183 · product_requirements_document 182 · github 181 · system_design_document 175 · market_research_report 173 · competitive_analysis 170. What the top 50 are, verbatim: real tech names (tensorflow, kubernetes, postgresql), compliance names (gdpr, ccpa), HERB's synthetic Salesforce product names (17 of the 50: collaborateforce, vizforce, forecastforce, actiongenie, searchflow), document types, process words (sprint_review, code_review, bug_resolution), sectors, and one PR-status word (merged, 169 chunks).

Random samples [MEASURED, seed 20260811]: 100 of the 12,924 single-chunk tags (8gb_ram, ai_powered_real_time_feedback, airflow_pr, corrupted_log_data_due_to_serialization_errors_issue, decision_no_changes_to_load_balancer_settings, elasticsearch_pr_1758, github_pr_302, https_github_com_salesforce_castaix_pull_1, pull_request_4977, revert_pr_13, update_security_module_to_use_modern_encryption_algorithm); 100 of the 3,429 tags in the 3–20 chunk band with their chunk counts (ai 10, ai_driven_lead_scoring 15, backend_processing_engine 17, github_pr_21 8, github_pr_44 10, jenkins 20, model_training_pipeline 11, pull_request_17 4); 50 of the 476 tags with 21+ chunks (autotuneforce 142, contentforce 111, data_encryption 136, jupyterlab 87, monitorforce 115, natural_language_processing 242, pr_review 83, product_planning 165, sentimentforce 144, supportforce 117).

String shape [MEASURED]. Character alphabet: every one of the 19,716 strings is lowercase [a-z0-9_] snake_case — zero contain a space, an uppercase letter, a hyphen, a dot, a slash, an @, or any non-ASCII character; whatever the tagger emitted was slugged to this alphabet before storage, so raw URLs, dates and titles survive only as underscore slugs. Length in characters: min 2, max 94, mean 24.4, median 22, banded 1–10: 1,108 · 11–20: 7,307 · 21–30: 6,322 · 31–40: 2,897 · 41–60: 2,017 · 61+: 65. No truncation wall: exactly 1 tag has length 94, 2 have ≥90, and S2 confirms the live DB max is also 94 with identical strings (both slugged Forbes URLs); the longest non-URL strings are complete sentences, e.g. fix_memory_leak_in_client_side_script_by_optimizing_dom_and_event_listener_management (85 chars); the shortest are 5g, ai, eu, qa, s3, ui, ux, 2fa, aix, api, aws, bug, ceo, cnn, crm. Length in tokens (split on _): mean 3.3, median 3, max 15, banded 1: 852 · 2: 6,764 · 3: 6,196 · 4: 2,192 · 5: 946 · 6+: 2,766.

Junk and reference classes [MEASURED]: URL slugs (start https_/http_) 1,217 tags 6.17%; URL-shaped including bare github_com_… 1,842 9.34%; PR pointers any form 2,505 12.71% — of which github_pr_N exactly 453 (2.30%), full https_github_com_owner_repo_pull_N 1,173 (5.95%), repo_pr_N shorthand 537 (2.72%); contains a digit 2,881 14.61%, and excluding the URL/PR classes only 354 1.80% (8gb_ram, tls_1_3_upgrade, aes_256_encryption); date/deadline/year-bearing excluding URL/PR 95 0.48% (q4_2023, april_15_2026_deadline, deadline_march_21_2026); money/quantity 19 0.10%; pure numbers 0; hex hashes / UUIDs 0; emails / file paths 0; boilerplate placeholders 0; single-token tags 852 4.32%, of which a generic lone noun 11 0.06%; truncated fragments 0 confirmed; run-ons ≥6 tokens 2,766 14.03%, and excluding URL/PR slugs 954 4.84%. The URL/PR classes overlap and dominate: their union is 2,556 tags (12.96%), accounting for 2,527 of the 2,881 digit-bearing tags and 1,812 of the 2,766 six-plus-token tags. The PR-pointer class carries 3,232 edges (4.76% of all edges) at mean degree 1.29, consistent with the 08-02 doc's independently measured 1.28 for slug tags.

Duplication [MEASURED]. Exact duplicates after normalization (casefold + separator collapse): 0 groups — all 19,716 raw strings stay distinct, because the slug alphabet already canonicalized case and punctuation, so there is no Foo-Bar vs foo_bar class at all. Singular/plural pairs: 584 groups, 1,170 tags (5.93%) — access_control/access_controls, parameter_adjustment/parameter_adjustments/parameters_adjustment. Same tokens, different order: 55 groups, 110 tags — analytics_data/data_analytics, 25_cagr/cagr_25, approval_lgtm/lgtm_approval. Joined vs separated: 43 groups, 86 tags — alert_manager/alertmanager, auto_scaling/autoscaling, einstein_auto_tuning/einsteinauto_tuning. Union of plural + reorder folding: 657 groups, 1,321 tags (6.70%) collapse into some other tag under stem+sort, the largest groups being three-way.

Redundancy structure [MEASURED, full computation, not sampled]: 5,070 tags (25.72%) are an exact substring of at least one other tag (casefolded, computed over the full vocabulary in 2.6 s) — 2fa ⊂ 2fa_feature, a_b_testing ⊂ a_b_testing_framework ⊂ dashboard_a_b_testing_framework; and 5,648 tags (28.65%) have their full token set contained in another tag's token set (full inverted-index computation, including the reorder pairs) — 24_7_support ⊆ 24_7_customer_support, 2_pm_meeting ⊆ 2026_01_27_2_pm_meeting, 2023_trends ⊆ https_www_forbes_com_sites_ai_forecasting_trends_2023.

Other measured observations about the strings. First-token families: github_* 1,266 + https_* 1,204 = 2,470 tags (12.5%); then data_* 732, ai_* 409, user_* 372, api_* 300, real_* 202, develop_* 199, decision_* 169, bug_* 137, incorrect_* 128. Synthetic product-name families: 1,027 tags contain force (excluding salesforce itself), 137 END in force — the HERB product names; 453 tags contain an aix-style product token (ortaix, paix, chaix, castaix, toraix, flowaix, ef_aix). Whole decisions as tags: 169 tags start decision_, each a full ruling (decision_no_algorithm_changes_needed, decision_do_not_merge_pr_25). Imperative sentences as tags, PR-title shaped: 451 tags start with a common imperative verb (fix_ 56, plus add/implement/update/optimize). PR-status words as standalone tags: merged 169 chunks, pr_review 83, approved 49, open 17, lgtm 12, closed 7, pr_merge 3, pr_proposal 2. Meeting/channel coordination tags: 493 containing slack/channel/meeting/standup/check_in/sync tokens. Job roles as tags: 31 ending in a role word — chief_product_officer 36, software_engineer 47, qa_specialist 44, engineering_lead 44.

[READING] — interpretation, kept minimal. The vocabulary reads as two populations sharing one namespace: a conceptual head (product names, tech names, process/document/sector words — the 21+ band is almost entirely this) and a referential tail (PR/URL pointers, dated deadlines, one-off full-sentence phrases — concentrated in the degree-1 band); the measured classes quantify each, and the split itself is the writer's framing, not a measurement. The 08-02 corpus-facts doc records that HERB's own docs treat a high singleton rate as expected for this tagger ("Raw tag names are expected to be specific and often new") and separately records the slug-copy breach of 'references, never copies'; both characterizations coexist and this doc does not arbitrate between them. No retag-or-not position is taken; that ruling is the user's.
